newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia allots $62 million to renew a railway line.
- Saudi plants producing carbon dioxide urged to boost their production.
- Belgium to finance the linking of 25 Palestinian villages with an electricity net.
- Around one million tourists are expected to visit Yemen in the year of 2000, official says.
